recommendation: Keep this fix. If UML diagrams are later regenerated, preserve the explicit StructureDefinition coordinates and consider whether the duplicate svg.svg artifact should remain, but do not revert the coordinate metadata because it prevents default-position overlaps.
issue_request: FHIR-38652 was Published/Persuasive for OO and asked to update the R5 DeviceDefinition UML diagram so classes do not overlap or extend beyond the frame.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied through DeviceDefinition SVG coordinate metadata: b385b2ff moved DeviceDefinition.packaging from 775,0 to 750,0, and 8254a1c restored DeviceDefinition.deviceName to 0,0 after an intermediate rebuild. The generated SVG was later deleted, then f964cdd reintroduced checked-in SVG diagram copies that still placed marketDistribution at the default 0,0 location.
additional_context: DeviceDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini and belongs to OO. Current source lacked a build SVG coordinate for DeviceDefinition.udiDeviceIdentifier.marketDistribution, causing the current SVG copies to overlap marketDistribution with deviceName. The combined branch already includes FHIR-49741, which restored DeviceDefinition.additive without a UML coordinate; this reconciliation adds a coordinate for that current backbone to prevent future generated UML from defaulting it to 0,0.
reconciliation: Added explicit build SVG coordinates for DeviceDefinition.udiDeviceIdentifier.marketDistribution and DeviceDefinition.additive in source/devicedefinition/structuredefinition-DeviceDefinition.xml. Moved the visible marketDistribution class and its linkage in source/devicedefinition/devicedefinition.svg and the duplicate source/devicedefinition/svg.svg copy. No DeviceDefinition semantic definitions, bindings, or cardinalities were changed.
source_changes: source/devicedefinition/structuredefinition-DeviceDefinition.xml: added build SVG coordinates for DeviceDefinition.additive and DeviceDefinition.udiDeviceIdentifier.marketDistribution.
source/devicedefinition/devicedefinition.svg: moved the marketDistribution class and linkage away from deviceName.
source/devicedefinition/svg.svg: kept the duplicate checked-in DeviceDefinition diagram copy in sync with devicedefinition.svg.
